understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid, modify the carried piece so its shape, color, and rotation matched each goal cell, and then step onto every goal to complete all levels.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement consumes stamina, and blocked moves still consume stamina without changing position. Shape modifiers cycle the piece's shape, color modifiers cycle its color, and rotation modifiers rotate it 90 degrees clockwise. A goal is activated only when all three attributes match simultaneously. Reaching zero stamina costs a life and resets stamina; losing all lives ends the game.
